record.dic_text:
01912 Hoduw {ho'-doo}

源自外來語; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - India 2; 2

印度 = "逃走" 或 "感謝你"
1) 一個被印度河圍繞的國家, 在此被提及用以表示亞哈隨魯帝國版圖的東邊邊界
record.edic_text:
01912 Hoduw {ho'-doo}

of foreign origin;; n pr loc

AV - India 2; 2

India = "flee away" or " give ye thanks"
1) the country surrounding the Indus, mentioned as the eastern border
   of the empire of Ahasuerus
